name: sonarlex
description: A daily word game in ChatGPT: guess the secret word, and each guess is ranked by how close its meaning is, hot-and-cold style. One word a day in English and one in Turkish, with hints, streaks and share squares that keep the word secret.

interface.shortDescription: Guess the word by its meaning
interface.longDescription:
Sonarlex is a daily word game in ChatGPT: guess the secret word, and each guess is ranked by how close its meaning is, hot-and-cold style. In English and Turkish. Every day everyone playing a language hunts the same secret word. Each turn you try up to 5 words, and each gets a number for how close it is in meaning to the secret word: #1 is the word itself, #2 its closest word, and the lower the number, the warmer you are. Find it in as few turns as you can.

Type your words in the card or just tell ChatGPT, for example "ocean, ship, salt". Plurals and other forms count as their base word, and in Turkish you can type without Turkish letters.

The secret word stays on Sonarlex's server: neither you nor ChatGPT can see it, so ChatGPT plays as an honest teammate. Ask it for ideas if you like; words it suggests are marked in your share squares.

Stuck? You get 3 hints a puzzle, each showing a word about halfway between your closest word so far and the secret, for one turn each. Give up and Sonarlex shows the word and its closest words. When you find it, the card shows today's median and coloured share squares that give nothing away. Your streak grows each day you solve it. New to the game? Start with the practice puzzle, whose word never changes.

Limits:
- One shared word a day per language: English (a new word at midnight UTC) and Turkish (at midnight Türkiye time). Sonarlex follows your ChatGPT language; say "in Turkish" or "in English" to switch.
- About 28,000 English and 22,000 Turkish words have a number. Phrases, very common words such as "the" and offensive words don't, and trying one costs nothing.
- Closeness comes from openly licensed word vectors (GloVe for English, fastText for Turkish), so it reflects how words are used, not a dictionary.
- No accounts: Sonarlex keeps your boards and streak under ChatGPT's anonymous user ID. Say "Delete my Sonarlex data" to delete them.

How to play, guides and privacy: sonarlex.ambientapp.ai.
defaultPrompt: Let's play a daily word game: guess the secret word by meaning
Give me a hint for today's word puzzle without spoiling it

positive.description: Open the practice puzzle. Run the five cases in order, in one new chat, by typing. There is nothing to sign in to: each ChatGPT user has their own board. The practice puzzle's secret word never changes, so the numbers below are exact on any day; "in English" keeps them exact even if your ChatGPT language is Turkish. If this ChatGPT account played the practice puzzle before (for example on a rerun), first say "Delete my Sonarlex data" and allow it, so the board starts empty. ChatGPT may open the card in a side panel instead of in the chat; the panel shows the same board.
positive.prompt: Start the Sonarlex practice puzzle in English and explain the rules.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows "Sonarlex · Practice" with an EN tag, 0 turns, 3 hints left, a word box and a short line on how to play. The reply explains that each turn takes up to 5 words, that each word gets a number for how close it is in meaning to the secret word (#1 is the word itself, lower is closer), and that fewer turns is better. ChatGPT names no guess at the secret word: it can't see it.

positive.description: Try three words in chat. Run after case 1. ChatGPT may show its own 'Allow ChatGPT to use Sonarlex?' prompt first; choose Allow once. The case passes with or without it. Typing the same three words in the card's word box instead gives the same numbers.
positive.expected_behavior: The card lists the words closest first: sea #18, ship #38, anchor #222, and shows 1 turn. The reply gives the three numbers and says sea is the closest so far, without guessing the secret word. Sending the same message again uses nothing: ChatGPT either calls guess_words again, and the result says no turn was used, or answers from the board that those words were already tried. Either way the board still shows 1 turn. (ChatGPT sometimes calls a tool twice for one message; the second call uses no turn either.)

positive.description: Ask for a hint. Run after case 2. A hint costs one turn.
positive.expected_behavior: The hint is "pier" at #10: about halfway between the closest word so far (sea, #18) and the secret word, never closer than #10. The card adds pier #10 with a bulb, shows 2 turns and 2 hints left. The reply gives the hint and its number.

positive.description: Find the word. Run after case 3.
positive.expected_behavior: "harbor" is #1, the secret word. The card shows harbor, "Found in 3 turns · 1 hint", its 10 closest words (harbour #2, bay #3, shore #4 and so on) and share squares that spell nothing out, with a Copy button. The word box is gone. The reply says the user found it, in 3 turns.

positive.description: Today's shared puzzle, then give up. Run after case 4 (or on its own). Today's secret word changes every day, so this case checks the flow rather than a word. Giving up ends today's puzzle for this user, so ChatGPT may ask you to confirm or show 'Allow ChatGPT to use Sonarlex?'; allow it. The case passes with or without the question. If this account already gave up on today's puzzle, the card simply shows it again.
positive.prompt: Open today's Sonarlex puzzle. I give up, what's the word?
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows today's "Sonarlex #" number, then, after the give-up, "The word was" with the word, "You gave up" and its 10 closest words. The reply names the word. Before the give-up, nothing in the chat or the card shows the word.

negative.description: A different word game. Sonarlex plays only its own daily hidden-word puzzle; ChatGPT plays this itself.
negative.prompt: Let's play hangman with a five-letter word.
negative.expected_behavior: No Sonarlex tool is called. ChatGPT runs the hangman game itself.

negative.description: A dictionary question. Sonarlex doesn't define words.
negative.expected_behavior: No Sonarlex tool is called. ChatGPT explains the word itself.

negative.description: Writing word puzzles is ChatGPT's own job.
negative.prompt: Write me three crossword clues for the word 'ocean'.
negative.expected_behavior: No Sonarlex tool is called. ChatGPT writes the clues itself.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: listing update. English and Turkish search keywords (daily word game, word guessing game, hot and cold word game, word games, kelime tahmin oyunu, günlük kelime oyunu and more), a subtitle and description that open with what the game is, a new icon (a letter tile on sonar rings), new starter prompts, and three skills: daily word game (the getting-started skill), hint or reveal, and streak and stats. The show_puzzle description and the server instructions name the game as a daily word game where each guess is ranked by closeness in meaning, hot-and-cold style (kelime tahmin oyunu in Turkish), and a finished daily puzzle says when the next word comes. The game, its tools and their inputs are unchanged.

tr-TR.subtitle: Günlük kelime tahmin oyunu
tr-TR.description:
Sonarlex günlük bir gizli kelime oyunu. Her gün o dili oynayan herkes aynı gizli kelimeyi arar. Her turda en fazla 5 kelime dener, her birinin gizli kelimeye anlamca ne kadar yakın olduğunu bir numarayla görürsün: #1 kelimenin kendisi, #2 en yakın kelimesi; numara küçüldükçe ısınırsın. Kelimeyi olabildiğince az turda bul.

Kelimelerini karta yaz ya da ChatGPT'ye söyle: "deniz, gemi, tuz" gibi. Çekimli biçimler kök kelime sayılır, Türkçe karakter şart değildir.

Gizli kelime Sonarlex'in sunucusunda durur: ne sen ne ChatGPT görebilir; ChatGPT dürüst bir takım arkadaşı olur. İstersen fikir sor; önerdiği kelimeler paylaşım karelerinde işaretlenir.

Takıldın mı? Bulmaca başına 3 ipucun var; her biri en iyi kelimenle gizli kelimenin yaklaşık ortasında bir kelime gösterir ve bir tur sayılır. Pes edersen Sonarlex kelimeyi ve en yakın kelimelerini gösterir. Bulunca kart günün medyanını ve hiçbir şey ele vermeyen renkli paylaşım karelerini gösterir. Her çözdüğün gün serin büyür. Yeni misin? Kelimesi hiç değişmeyen alıştırma bulmacasıyla başla.

Sınırlar:
- Her dilde günde bir ortak kelime: Türkçe (gece yarısı, TSİ) ve İngilizce (03:00, TSİ). Sonarlex ChatGPT dilini izler.
- Türkçede yaklaşık 22.000, İngilizcede yaklaşık 28.000 kelimenin numarası var. Kelime grupları, "ve" gibi çok yaygın kelimeler ve küfürler listede yoktur; denemek tur harcamaz.
- Hesap yok: tahtaların ve serin ChatGPT'nin anonim kimliğiyle saklanır. "Sonarlex verilerimi sil" diyerek silebilirsin.
